# OpenApply

> OpenApply is a free, open-source (MIT) job application tracker. Paste a job posting link and it fills in the company, role, and description; track status, notes, contacts, and interviews in one place. It also ships a free, no-signup tool that checks a resume against a job description.

OpenApply is not affiliated with Faria's OpenApply, a school admissions platform at openapply.com. This site is openapply.app, a job search tool for individual job seekers.

## Tools

- [Resume vs job description match checker](https://openapply.app/tools/resume-job-match): Free, no signup. Paste a resume and a job description and get a match score, every requirement marked matched, partial, or missing with the resume line that proves it, the ATS keywords that are missing, and what a parser actually reads from an uploaded PDF. It never rewrites the resume or invents experience; every match must be backed by a quote from the resume text. The full prompt used is shown on the page.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://openapply.app/): Paste a link to a public careers page to create a tracked application with company, role, and description filled in automatically (LinkedIn and Indeed block this: paste the description, or use the browser extension once it's listed). Track status, notes, contacts, and interviews. Tracking is free, with 15 AI checks a month for resume reviews and cover letters; Pro is $9 a month for 150.
- [App (sign in required)](https://openapply.app/app/): The job application tracker itself.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/SergeyKhval/OpenApply): MIT-licensed source. Vue 3 + Vite SPA, Astro marketing site, Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Functions), Google Genkit with Gemini for AI features. Self-hostable with your own Firebase project and Gemini API key.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://openapply.app/blog): Job search, resume, and interview advice, including ATS optimization and AI resume review guides.
